verdict.rationale: Abacum is an AI-native FP&A platform with built-in AI (AI Modeler), so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions MCP or any way to connect external tool servers. Its documented integrations are ERP, CRM, HRIS and Excel data connectors, which are a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
